resolution.note: guard allows squash-merged tips (patch-id of the unpushed range on a remote) and reads the claim worktree's task copy; test/claude/unpushed-delete-hook.test.ts red before, green after

title: Unpushed-delete guard accepts squash-merged tips and the claim worktree's record
body:
Outcome: the unpushed-delete PreToolUse guard (src/hook/unpushed-delete.ts) allows removing a branch or worktree whose tip is already on the base by patch-id (squash merge), and it finds the 'Unpushed work:' record that `krn task edit --append-body` writes into the claiming worktree's tasks/<id>.json, not only the root copy.
Why: 2026-11-16 lead: removing the merged S28 step-1 worktree (377742e, squash 706c874, same patch-id) was refused; the suggested `krn task edit --append-body` wrote into the claimed worktree's task file, so the guard still refused until the claim was released.
Proof: node --test test/hook/unpushed-delete.test.ts: pass with cases for a squash-merged tip and a record in the claim worktree.
